units.note: First sentence: Greek is contrastive (οὐ χρὴ τοῖς τοιούτοις ... τῷ δ᾽ Ἀγαθοκλεῖ καὶ Διονυσίῳ, 'not to such men, but to Agathocles and Dionysius'); English 'in the way one might with' preserves the sense acceptably. Names (Publius Scipio = first conqueror of Carthage, Agathocles and Dionysius of Syracuse) correct.
'beginning of his reign' for κατὰ τὰς ἀρχάς is a slight specification, not an error class.
